mapper.select: UPDATE rt_retry_task t SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), updated_at = now() WHERE t.id IN ( SELECT id FROM rt_retry_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= now() ORDER BY next_retry_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) RETURNING t.id, t.route_id, t.config_version, t.message_id, t.topic, t.tag, t.payload, t.error_stage, t.error_code, t.error_message, t.attempt, t.max_attempt, t.next_retry_at, t.status, t.lease_until, t.last_error_at, t.created_at, t.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE rt_retry_task SET status = 'PENDING', lease_until = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < now()
mapper.select: INSERT INTO rt_retry_task (route_id, config_version, message_id, topic, tag, payload, error_stage, error_code, error_message, attempt, max_attempt, next_retry_at, status, last_error_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{task.routeId}, #{task.configVersion}, #{task.messageId}, #{task.topic}, #{task.tag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{task.payload,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{task.errorStage}, #{task.errorCode}, #{task.errorMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{task.attempt}, #{task.maxAttempt}, #{task.nextRetryAt}, 'PENDING', #{task.lastErrorAt}, #{task.createdAt}, #{task.updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (route_id, message_id) WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') DO UPDATE SET next_retry_at = EXCLUDED.next_retry_at, error_stage = EXCLUDED.error_stage, error_code = EXCLUDED.error_code, error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message, last_error_at = EXCLUDED.last_error_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at RETURNING id
